marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind light increasing to northwest 15 knots late overnight and
to northwest 25 early Friday morning. Wind diminishing to northwest 15 Friday
afternoon. Scattered flurries changing to snow near midnight then to
scattered flurries Friday afternoon. Visibility as low as 1 mile in
snow. Temperatures near minus 1. <br/>

marine.text: Over open water seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
